description: This file contains utility functions for reading the contents of a file into memory and printing input/output data, primarily used for unit testing. It includes operations like opening files, seeking, reading, and printing memory contents related to test utilities.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test utility memory structure, handling file opening, seeking, reading, and error conditions.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a file or provided data to the console, utilizing the file reading function to load file contents before printing.
